title: Output Encoding
description: Encode data before rendering to prevent injection in responses.

data.text:
**Output Encoding**

Output encoding converts special characters into safe equivalents before data reaches the browser or client.

items: HTML attribute: encode quotes and angle brackets
CSS: escape backslashes and closing braces

data.text: React escapes values by default in JSX. The risk appears when using dangerouslySetInnerHTML, injecting into <a href>, or constructing strings for eval().

data.title: Safe vs Unsafe React

items: ASP.NET Core auto-encodes Razor views by default
Return structured data (JSON) rather than HTML strings

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encode at the point of output, not input
APIs should return JSON, not HTML
data.takeaway: Proper output encoding neutralizes injection regardless of input content.
